source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Biomedical Manufacturing output in 2019 was influenced by pharmaceutical batch production, drug production, and biologics production.
Healthcare demand, medical technology demand, and vaccine production shaped selected biomedical activities.
Plant schedule effects and batch production cycles affected output movements during the year.
Biomedical manufacturing reflected product mix, production timing, and healthcare-related demand.
